heroDescription: The lessons, decisions, and hard-won insights of exceptional people in tech, shared through honest conversations. So you can learn from their experience and build your own path.
storyTitle:
The journey is
more interesting
than the
storyFirst: “Got into GSoC.” “Landed a remote job.” “Started working in AI.” We see the milestones. We don’t always hear about the first attempts, wrong turns, and small decisions that came before.
storySecond: That’s what MaheshLabs is for. We sit down with people building their way through tech and ask the questions we’d want to ask as friends. The practical stuff. The uncertain stuff. The story behind the résumé.
storySignoff: No perfect roadmaps. Just useful perspectives.
teamIntro: We’re Mahesh Nandigam and Mahesh Moholkar, two friends talking with people about how they found their way in tech.
newsletterDescription: Early access to new podcasts, straight to your inbox.
